texts.preamble: Sanjay Awasthi vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 January, 2020 Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Court No. - 13 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 319 of 2013 Revisionist :- Sanjay Awasthi Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Revisionist :- Narendra Kumar Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J. 1.
texts.facts: 4. The revisionist is a tea-seller; on 18.05.1999, at around 4.00 p.m., the Food Inspector found the revisionist selling 6 liter adulterated milk of buffalo and cow, without possessing valid licence; after disclosing his identity, the Food Inspector bought 750 m.l. milk; some part of the milk was sent for analysis to the Public Analyst on 19.05.1999; in his report dated 25.06.1999, the Public Analyst found the milk solids-not-fact 26% less than the prescribed limit.
texts.arguments: 5. Counsel for the revisionist submits that the milk fat was not injurious to human health; only the milk solids-not-fat was less than the prescribed limit. The learned counsel further submits that the incident took place around 21 years before; the revisionist has undergone around 18 days imprisonment. The learned counsel places reliance on judgment in 'Sughar Singh Vs. State and another' (Criminal Revision No.985 of 1991) in which this Court, after considering the facts of the case, which are identical to the present one, found the offence to be of very minor nature. The milk solids-not-fat was not injurious to the health. 6. The Supreme Court in Nand Lal v. State of Uttarakhand and others, 2010 (4) SCC 562, after considering the age of the appellant in that case, and taking into account the fact that the incident was very old, reduced the sentence to the period already undergone.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 5. Counsel for the revisionist submits that the milk fat was not injurious to human health; only the milk solids-not-fat was less than the prescribed limit. The learned counsel further submits that the incident took place around 21 years before; the revisionist has undergone around 18 days imprisonment. The milk solids-not-fat was not injurious to the health.
